name: spelling-launcher
title: Spelling Launcher
description: Native macOS spelling, grammar, and tone assistant for any app using Apple Silicon proofreading services and local Ollama with zero cloud telemetry.
author: antigravity

commands.name: rewrite-selection
commands.title: Rewrite Selected Text
commands.subtitle: Spelling Launcher
commands.description: Opens side-by-side tone rewrites and diffs for currently highlighted text and pastes back into your active app.

commands.name: quick-fix
commands.title: Quick Polish & Paste
commands.subtitle: Spelling Launcher
commands.description: Analyses selected text for spelling and grammar errors, then pastes back corrected text with a brief notification explaining what changed.

preferences.name: ollamaHost
preferences.title: Ollama Host URL (Optional Rewriter)
preferences.description: Local Ollama server URL (defaults to http://localhost:11434, used only for multi-version tone rewrites)

preferences.name: ollamaModel
preferences.title: Ollama Model (Optional Rewriter)
preferences.description: Local model name to use for rewriting

scripts.build: ray build -e dist -o dist && cp dist/*.js .
scripts.sync: mkdir -p ~/.config/raycast/extensions/spelling-launcher/assets && cp -r assets/* ~/.config/raycast/extensions/spelling-launcher/assets/ && cp package.json quick-fix.js* rewrite-selection.js* ~/.config/raycast/extensions/spelling-launcher/
